title: Reforge cost 25 x (t-6) shards
steps: Seed T9 Rare Spark Wand, open Forge with a real click/tap
Reforge a T8 wand with Confirm
actual: T9 options read '70 dust + 75 shards'; T8 reforge charged 50 dust + 50 shards once

title: Forge line 'N more kills of dust'
expected: Correct kill counts, line gone when affordable
actual: '13 more kills of dust, shards are enough', '7 more kills of shards, dust is enough', '15 more kills of dust and 8 of shards', no line when enough

title: Double-tap Confirm reforge guard (b02-12)
status: VERIFIED for double taps; slow rhythm see b02-r3-01
steps: Tap Confirm reforge twice at 0, 90, 340 ms (touch) and dblclick / 0-700 ms (mouse)
actual: Wand reforged once and charged once in all cases; no salvage confirm at <=340 ms

title: First-kill bag floor
steps: Level 8 hero, seed 12345, teleport beside the zone-1 boss Treant Elder, finish it, read recap
Reload, kill the same boss again
expected: First kill floored (>= pink), bit set once
actual: firstKill=true, bag purple, zk=2, banner and Warding Ring; after reload firstKill=false and zk unchanged. No baseline to show the floor changed an outcome (seeded rolls); boss finished with a hook, not real fire

title: Godlands elite drops (giant spider queen)
steps: Teleport around the three zone-3 altars, 2.2 s dwell, 30 hops, scan liveEnemies for giant_spider_queen
expected: Elite met and killed, T9-T11 drop
actual: No queen met; only zone 1/2 enemies listed, zone-3 spawns not observed after a teleport (probably a teleport artefact)

title: Slow double-tap (about 450 ms) opens the Salvage confirm; a third tap destroys the wand
steps: Phone 390x844, T8 Spark Wand, Forge, pick Blast
Tap Confirm reforge, 450 ms later tap the same spot, 0.5 s later tap again
expected: Salvage confirm should not open under a repeat tap, or sit elsewhere
actual: Second tap opens 'Confirm salvage +17 dust' (wand intact); third tap salvaged the wand

title: Floating loot labels overlap on a boss kill
steps: Kill the zone-1 boss, look under the hero
actual: 'Warding Ring' draws over a 'Warding Wand' label

title: Forge hint line and reforge list sit below the fold on phone
steps: Phone 390x844, open Forge on the equipped weapon
actual: Only Salvage and the first hint line are visible; the reforge options need scrolling
